title: cAMP (Cyclic Adenosine Monophosphate) Levels in the Nose
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the normal distribution of nasal tissue cathelicidin antimicrobial peptides (cAMP) levels in subjects with normal smell and subjects with smell dysfunction. The investigators will also look at the effect of nasal saline irrigation on olfaction and cAMP levels and if nasal irrigation is capable of harvesting olfactory cilia. The investigators hypothesize that nasal saline will have no effect on olfaction and will be inadequate to harvest olfactory cilia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Normal olfactory function cohort:

* self-reported normal smell function
* age greater than 18 years

Olfactory dysfunction cohort:

* ICD9 diagnostic code for olfactory dysfunction
* idiopathic olfactory dysfunction
* age greater than 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* allergy to lidocaine
* active upper respiratory infection
* previous nasal or sinus surgery
* current tobacco use
* unable to give consent due to language barrier, cognitive or medical issues
